description: Mirror of unknown_capability_tolerated.json from the CLIENT's perspective: welcome carries a capability string the client has never heard of. OVERVIEW.md section 2.7: capability negotiation is additive and forward-compatible -- an unrecognized capability token is not a validation failure. Followed by one full ping/pong liveness round trip (server-initiated, since both sides ping independently per section 2.9) to demonstrate the connection is genuinely healthy afterward, not merely un-closed.
